label: Celda Remachado — Arquitectura Modbus/TCP
info:
DEMOSTRATIVO — Arquitectura de la Celda de Remachado Schneider.

La Raspberry Pi 4 es el PLC/Gateway central:
  • Cobot JAKA LXMRL03S0000  → Modbus TCP :6502 + TLS/JSON :10000/:10001 + FTP :2121
  • Datalogic P15 Camera      → HTTP :80 + Telnet :23 + CORBA :10001
  • Schneider HMI             → Modbus TCP :502 (master)
  • Gemelo Digital (browser)  → WSS ngrok tunnel

Subnets: 192.168.1.0/24 (industrial) + 10.5.5.0/24 (cobot nativo)
NAT via iptables MASQUERADE en RPi para rutear entre ambas redes.

Dependencias: node-red-contrib-modbus  node-red-node-pi-gpio

─────  Modbus TCP  FC04  :6502  Unit:1  @100ms  ─────
◀ RPi actúa como CLIENTE Modbus — cobot es SERVIDOR (solo lectura, FC04)
◀ Big-Endian FLOAT32 pairs para datos continuos, UINT16 para estados

Regs 382–393  FLOAT32×6  (12 words)
Joint Positions  J1…J6  [°]
J1:±360  J2/J3:±150  J4:±180  J5:±120  J6:±180

Regs 406–417  FLOAT32×6  (12 words)
TCP Position  X,Y,Z [mm]  Rx,Ry,Rz [°]
Regs 418–429: TCP Speed [mm/s] [°/s]

Regs 316–327  INT32×6  Temperaturas [°C]
Regs 358–369  FLOAT32×6  Corrientes [A]
Regs 370–381  FLOAT32×6  Fuerza/Torque EE

Regs 454–462  UINT16×9  Robot Status
powered/enabled/mode/error/inpos/collision
Regs 394–405: Joint Speeds [°/s]

TLS :10000  →  JSON Stream
~6 KB por paquete  @100ms  (cert auto-firmado)
joint_position, cartesian_position, enabled, task_state

TLS :10001  ←→  JSON Commands
joint_move  /  enable_robot  /  power_on
gripper (DO6)  /  conveyor (DO13)  /  stop

FTP/TLS :2121
Upload / Download  programas .jks
(JAKA Script  —  secuencias de movimiento)

Digital Outputs  (via TLS:10001)
DO6  (idx 5):  Gripper Magnético
DO7/8 (idx 6/7): Gripper Neumático
DO13 (idx 12): Motor Conveyor  CN4

Digital Inputs  (via TLS:10001)
DI9  (idx 8):  Photoelectric Conveyor  CN3
DI11 (idx 10): Sensor Visión  CN3

────  Modbus TCP Slave :502  @200ms  ────
◀ RPi = MASTER  |  HMI = SLAVE
◀ FC01 read coils  |  FC05/FC15 write coils  |  FC03/FC16 holding regs

WRITE  Coils 1–15  (FC15)
💡 Indicadores LED  —  RPi → HMI
Conveyor/Fixture/Cobot/Gripper/Camera/Table/Rivet/Stacklight

READ  Coils 101–106  (FC01)
🔘 Botones Panel Operador  —  HMI → RPi
START / STOP / RESUME / RESTART / CONFIRM / FINALIZE

WRITE  Holding Regs 1–4  (FC16)
Reg 1: Total piezas  Reg 2: Aceptadas
Reg 3: Rechazadas    Reg 4: Estado Cámara 0-4

Polling @200ms  |  Pull-up config.txt gpio=24,25=ip,pu
Stacklight: Verde=OK  Amarillo=Warning  Rojo=Error/Parada
